title: No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting future embeddings, but the objective admits a trivial solution of a constant encoder, so every practical system adds an anti-collapse mechanism (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2022; 2024). LeWorldModel (LeWM) prevents collapse with SIGReg, a regularizer that forces the latent distribution to match an isotropic Gaussian: the representation is stabilized by prescribing what it must look like, independently of the environment it models. translated_title: 无需高斯分布：用于JEPA世界模型的对比逆动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17542v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过预测未来嵌入来学习世界模型，但该目标允许一个平凡解，即恒定编码器，因此每个实际系统都添加了防坍缩机制（LeCun, 2022; Assran等人, 2023; Bardes等人, 2022; 2024）。LeWorldModel（LeWM）使用SIGReg正则化器防止坍缩，该正则化器强制潜在分布匹配各向同性高斯分布：通过规定表示必须呈现的形式来稳定它，而独立于其建模的环境。我们认为防坍缩压力可以来自过渡数据本身。动作对比掩码过渡建模（AC-MTM）保留了LeWM的前向潜在预测目标，并添加了一个仅用于训练的逆动力学头，使用Action-NCE进行训练：每个潜在过渡必须在批次中的其他动作中识别出产生它的动作，这是一个坍缩编码器无法完成的判别任务。
tldr: 本文提出AC-MTM方法，利用动作对比逆动力学从过渡数据中提供防坍缩压力，替代传统高斯正则化，从而无需显式分布约束即可稳定JEPA世界模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AC-MTM, which uses action-contrastive inverse dynamics to provide anti-collapse pressure from transition data, replacing conventional Gaussian regularization to stabilize JEPA world models without explicit distribution constraints.
